t_reason_check: TP-109 (./.dsh-ref/evidence/books/t-items-TP.md:799-804) deletes A8-1d because the seeded pre-D-7 ledger 'is not produced by the current writer' and says current behaviour is covered by tests/scenarios/A7-control.test.ts:110 D-7 and tests/runtime/A2-reconcile-runtime.test.ts:232 W-05. The first half holds only for the committed shape the test seeded (control-service.ts:269-277 applies a pause on a Claimed/Authorized/Revoked Run at once), but not for a pause submitted while the Run is Entering: submissionEventOf sends it as control_submitted (control-service.ts:272-277), the Run pointer becomes paused (run-machine.ts:1843), and RUN-16 settles that queued pause in the same commit (run-machine.ts:2217-2223). nodeBefore is forced to Revoked for reconcile_not_entered (run-reconcile-service.ts:870-871), so line 166 evaluates intent.kind === 'pause' and writes kind 'paused' (reconcile-intents.ts:163-167). W-05 submits only 'cancel' (tests/runtime/A2-reconcile-runtime.test.ts:243) and asserts only the cancelled observation (:261-262); A7-control.test.ts:110-146 covers the control-service applied-at-once path (control-intent-machine.ts:691), not reconcile-intents.ts:166. The statement 'current behaviour covered by W-05' therefore fails for this line: the live queued-pause settlement has no after-T test.

rows.note: Line 166's first cond-expr arm ('paused') belongs to the not-entered reconcile. It is reachable without tampering through a real fault: a pause submitted while the Run is Entering is queued (control-service.ts:272-277; run-machine.ts:1960-1980, 1842-1846), then the executor dies before turn.started (restart takeover, run-reconcile.ts:322 W-05; in-process Kernel-call failure, execution-driver.ts:1272-1275, 1292-1324). RUN-16 emits control_reconciled for the queued pause (run-machine.ts:2217-2223), run-reconcile-service.ts:870-871 sets nodeBefore 'Revoked', and reconcile-intents.ts:163-167 writes observation {origin:'platform_not_entered', kind:'paused', detail:{entryPhase:'revoked'}}. After T no test executes this arm: W-05 only submits cancel (tests/runtime/A2-reconcile-runtime.test.ts:243) and asserts kind 'cancelled' (:261-262); A8-host-restart-entry.test.ts:148-180 is also cancel-only; the deleted A8-1d pause case (./.dsh-ref/before/tests/runtime/A2-reconcile-runtime.test.ts:546-584) was the only cover. So T's delete of the seeded pre-D-7 test was right for that state, but the claim that W-05 covers the current RUN-16 pause behaviour is wrong; class F (real crash/Kernel failure, existing seam), hypothesis not refuted.
